svg.aria-label: What a coding run started from Shift Manager is handed, today and after, as the prompt reads top to bottom. Today: the task a person approved is on the row but dropped from the prompt; the run gets the seat's instructions, the seat's standing brief document treated as the job, the team's conventions, and the row's id, checkout and branch. After: the prompt opens on the approved task (its goal, title, context and any prior outputs the board selected), then the seat's instructions, the standing brief as reference, the conventions, the charter of the channel the task sits on when the seat is a member, and the run's terms including when it counts as done. Below a fence, never handed either way: the coordinator seat's session, the channel transcript, and environment keys.

g.text: TODAY · THE PROMPT, TOP TO BOTTOM
The task a person approved: dropped
on the row the run works, never in its prompt
The seat's instructions
The seat's standing brief, read as the job
so an approved night-mode toggle runs as a greeting module
The team's conventions
This row: its id, checkout and branch
and that a commit counts as done
AFTER
The task: the goal a person approved
with its title, context and prior outputs, when the row has them
The seat's instructions
The seat's standing brief, as reference
the task says what to build; the brief says how the team works
The team's conventions
The channel's charter
the channel the task sits on, only when the seat is a member
The run's terms: checkout, branch, what counts as done
NEVER HANDED, TODAY OR AFTER
The coordinator seat's session · the channel transcript · environment keys
Detail a run needs goes on the task. A person's later messages keep arriving their own way.
